Application Data.NAME: Elegant Celebrations LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Elegant Celebrations LLC specializes in providing a full range of wedding services, including wedding planning, venue coordination, catering, floral arrangements, photography, and entertainment. We operate a beautifully designed chapel that accommodates ceremonies of various sizes and styles, catering to the unique needs of each couple. Our experienced team is dedicated to creating memorable experiences for weddings, anniversaries, and other special events.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 05/15/2022, due to a sudden storm, the venue experienced water damage causing disruption to a scheduled wedding event, resulting in repair costs amounting to $1,500. The claim was settled and the repairs were completed by 06/30/2022.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security personnel on-site during events, perimeter fencing around the chapel, and regular safety inspections conducted to ensure a secure environment for weddings and events.
